description: This source file defines the ProtobufCodec class within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. The class implements serialization and cloning logic for protobuf messages, including methods for deep copying, type support checks, and reading/writing protobuf data. It utilizes Google's protobuf IMessage interface and related parsers, acting as a key component in Orleans' serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: ProtobufCodec
classes.description: Sealed class implementing protobuf serialization, deep copying, and type filtering for Orleans serialization pipeline.
